listings.description: About Magic Eden and Dicey Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets. We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up. The role Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own. This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer. What you'll do Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable What we're looking for Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others Comfortable with ambiguity. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Â Outcomes Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets. Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable. AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences. Â The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch. Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce. Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that. The Social Comms role : We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment. As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public. You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work. You'd be a great fit if You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious. You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you. You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about. You have experience in civic domains, public-good, policy, trust-and-safety, or non-profits. Bonus: you have already published material relevant to AI and its proliferation and risks. listings.description: About the role The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company. About Arabian Private Holdings Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets. What you will do Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment. Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations. Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies. Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals. Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates. Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized. Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews. Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports. What we are looking for A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving. Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors. Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English. Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors. Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review. A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics. How we work We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients. What the role offers A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market. Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates. Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region. The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote. Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz , Knuspr.de , Kifli.hu , Gurkerl.at and Sezamo.ro , choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows. We are building the autonomous grocer. Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match. We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job. You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them. What you will own and deliver The capture spec. Cameras, mounts, calibration, and what disqualifies an episode. You write it before we buy the fleet and enforce it after. When the spec and the floor disagree, you go to the floor and find out which one is wrong. Ground truth. Hand pose is the signal that transfers from human video to robot policies, and warehouse reality — work gloves, occlusion, cold halls — is exactly where the published models struggle. You own how we measure that and how we close the gap. The evaluation harness. The corpus only counts if a policy can train on it. You build the harness that decides which hours make the bank, and you hold the trainability bar as the volume grows. The first training runs. Once hours bank, you post-train open robot-learning models on our data and run the first task evaluations. Judgment before spend. The field moves monthly. You read what is published, reproduce the claims we depend on, and steer our capture before the money is spent, not after. The scope This is a seat on a small, newly created team: an operations lead who runs capture on the floor, a data engineer who owns the pipeline, and you: the machine-learning voice in the room. This is not a research-scientist role, and no publication record is required. The job is to make a corpus trainable and to train the first policies on it. What we are looking for PyTorch, and computer vision with real 3D geometry. Camera calibration, pose estimation, SLAM fundamentals. You have debugged an extrinsic calibration at least once in your life and know why it drifted. You can read a paper and reproduce it. Our pipeline is assembled from published work, and your job is knowing which claims survive contact with a chilled warehouse hall. You know what policies train on. Familiar with the current robot-learning stack and policy classes well enough to know what the training side will demand of the data before the data exists. Dataset instincts. You have trained on data you collected yourself, and you know the failure modes that only show up at training tim.. Comfortable as the only ML voice. You make the call, write it down, and revisit it when the pilot data says otherwise. AI is how work gets done here. Our engineers use Claude Code and Devin daily, and we expect you to direct agents for the unglamorous parts — harness code, data plumbing, reproduction scripts — while keeping the quality bar exactly where it was. Particularly relevant. Hand-pose estimation or egocentric video in production; multi-camera rigs and time sync; experience post-training robot-learning models; ROS 2. listings.description: About the team: The Commercial Systems and Intelligence squad is a newly formed team within SumUp's Acquisition Mission under the Run & Grow tribe. We sit at the intersection of data, backend engineering, and sales operations, building the infrastructure that powers how SumUp attributes merchant acquisition, calculates commissions, and understands the full lifecycle of every merchant. Today, these processes are largely manual. We're here to change that, automating what's opaque, and building systems that sales representatives, leadership, and analysts can actually trust. You'll join at the very beginning, helping to shape how the squad works, the architecture it builds on, and the standards it holds itself to.   What you'll do: Aggregating data from across the SumUp ecosystem to determine which acquisition channel or sales agent drove a merchant to take a valuable action (e.g. signing up, adopting a product) Establishing data models, API contracts, and rule definitions that automate existing manual commission workflows for field and tele-sales agents, partnerships and merchant referrals Build the Lifecycle Event Log in close collaboration with the Merchant Intelligence squad. A centralized store of curated merchant lifecycle events (signups, product usage, verification, purchases) used across attribution, recommendations, customer support and sales Build internal backoffices and APIs for sales representatives and leaders to monitor commission and modify commission plans, manage portfolios and resolve disputes Define and document API contracts, schemas, and integration patterns that other engineering teams can adopt confidently Establish best practices for testing, observability, and incident response within a newly formed squad Use AI and agentic coding tools deliberately, to scaffold services, write tests, explore unfamiliar code, and draft documentation while maintaining full accountability for what gets shipped   You'll be great for this role if you: Bring a strong backend engineering background in Go, or are a typed-language generalist ready to ramp up quickly Have designed APIs and distributed systems with clear contracts, versioning, and integration patterns Are fluent in relational and analytical databases (PostgreSQL, Snowflake) and comfortable making the right choice for the right use case Have built Kafka-based, event-driven systems and understand event sourcing and CDC patterns Have experience in auditable, high-trust systems where every decision must be traceable — fintech, payments, or similar domains Have built services from scratch in greenfield, early-stage squads with limited prior context,  and are energized, not unsettled, by that challenge Have experience with testing, observability, and incident response practices and treat them as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts Are resourceful and adaptable, you take end-to-end ownership, do more with less, and adjust quickly as priorities shift Can bridge technical and non-technical audiences, translating fuzzy problems into clear engineering work and explaining trade-offs to engineers and sales stakeholders alike Are pragmatic, you know when good enough ships value and when something genuinely needs to be done properly Have mentorship instincts, you raise the bar for the people around you, not just your own output   Why you should join SumUp: 🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup 🧑‍🔬 We take learning and experimentation seriously with Hack Days every second Friday, and entire global Hack Weeks . 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2,000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education 🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP program: You will own a stake in SumUp's future success 💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions 🔄 30 Days Sabbatical: Enjoy the unique opportunity to take a well-deserved break with our 30 days sabbatical benefit after completing 3 years of employment with SumUp 🔗 Referral Bonus: Earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team 🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, relocation assistance, subsidised office lunches SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. Today, over 4 million businesses in 36 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships. Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. listings.description: Headquarters: Oakland, CA URL: https://www.trackitforward.com We are looking for a lead developer to do a greenfield rebuild of our legacy SaaS app, modernize our mobile apps, and lead the tech effort to scale our app. You will help choose the language, build the technical foundation, work with our product manager to rebuild the app, and migrate all customers over. About Track it Forward Track it Forward is the leading volunteer time-tracking application for nonprofits and schools. For 15 years, we’ve helped thousands of organizations mobilize volunteers and track over 30 million hours. We are a profitable, bootstrapped team of 4 focused on great work-life balance, high-impact work, and a fun, puzzle-loving culture (daily crosswords, monthly virtual escape rooms, and annual retreats). We are not a VC-funded startup. We grew organically, stayed profitable, and prioritize high-quality work and personal fulfillment without growth-at-all-costs pressure. The team is led by the original founder and developer. The Modernization Strategy This is a structured, phased "small bang" migration—not a high-risk cutover or a strangler-fig migration. You will build a parallel greenfield system, extract legacy components step-by-step, and migrate customers over incrementally tenant-by-tenant while keeping operations running smoothly. Current Tech : Drupal 6 architecture hosted on Pantheon, paired with two Ionic/Capacitor mobile apps. Your Scope: Complete ownership of the technical architecture. You will partner with our product manager, establish engineering processes, and lead the rebuild from scratch. Modern AI practices : We want you to be on the cusp of AI workflows while also balancing human guardrails to produce quality code. Team Structure: You will be our sole developer in the short term, taking full technical helm as we scale. Target Stack & Responsibilities Core Tech Stack: Core backend/frontend rebuild focused on Python/Django, Laravel, or React. You will make the final architectural call with input from the CEO/founder. Database & Storage Extraction: Deconstruct our legacy Drupal 6 / MySQL schema into a clean, domain-driven PostgreSQL database, and offload 100GB+ of media files to AWS S3 or Cloudflare R2. Security & Isolation : Implement application-layer field-level encryption (AES-256 for PII, Bcrypt/Argon2id for passwords) and build zero-trust dev environments so contractors never handle production user data. CI/CD & Documentation: Establish automated testing pipelines, clean API contracts, and clear runbooks so the codebase remains maintainable long-term. Mobile App Maintenance: Maintain and update our two Ionic/Capacitor mobile apps using AI coding tools. Mobile is a small fraction of the overall role—you just need to leverage AI to keep them functional without being a native mobile expert. Candidate Qualifications Pre-AI Engineering Foundation: 5+ years of core software engineering and architectural experience established before generative AI existed. You hold strong first-principles opinions on database normalization and system patterns. Proven Migration Experience: You have successfully architected and led at least one legacy monolith migration. You know what inputs and scope decisions keep momentum going. Modernized AI Velocity: You actively use AI tools to multiply output, but retain strict architectural control, unit testing discipline, and manual code review standards. Location & Remote Flexibility US W-2 Tax Residency Required: You must be legally authorized to work in the US and maintain primary US tax residency (for payroll, contracts, and legal/tax compliance). Travel-Friendly: We are 100% remote. As long as your primary legal/tax home remains in the US, you are welcome to travel or digital nomad—provided you can consistently hit our core sync hours. Core Sync Hours: Mandatory availability from 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM PST for daily team syncs and real-time collaboration. Flexible hours outside this window. Compensation & Benefits Base Salary: $150,000 – $200,000 / year (commensurate with experience) Benefits: 401(k) w/ company match, Health Insurance, vacation, PTO, and holdiays Culture: High autonomy, direct project ownership, and zero venture-capital growth pressure How to Apply To filter out automated spam: include the most authentically human, non-AI reason why this specific role resonates with you. Specifically include a short Loom video of you in the “Why should we choose you over any one else?” question. This isn’t required but will sure stand out. Be authentic, no need to do crazy rehearsals, just be you. Apply at this google form here To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/track-it-forward-lead-developer-rebuild-modernize-scale-social-good-saas-remote

listings.role: Senior Integration Engineer for Enterprise API & Integration Products
listings.description: Headquarters: Summary We are looking for a Senior Integration Engineer to build and operate integration products connecting Salesforce, SAP, and a carrier data lake. This role combines hands-on integration development with end-to-end production ownership, including API design, data mapping, testing, monitoring, troubleshooting, and recovery. General information This role focuses on building reliable, maintainable integrations rather than creating new point-to-point integration debt. You will work across Salesforce, SAP, and carrier data lake environments, taking ownership of integrations throughout their lifecycle—from implementation and testing through production support and continuous improvement. Strong experience with MuleSoft or a comparable enterprise integration/API platform is expected, along with practical experience integrating with SAP and working with data lake ingestion patterns. AI-assisted engineering is an explicit expectation for this engagement. You will use AI copilots and agents as part of your daily workflow to accelerate discovery, development, testing, documentation, and operational troubleshooting. You will remain responsible for validating and hardening AI-generated output and for all production decisions. Tasks and Deliverables Design and implement MuleSoft/API integrations across Salesforce, SAP, and the carrier data lake. Define and maintain API contracts, field mappings, transformations, and automated tests. Use Data Modeler to develop and maintain accurate data mappings between systems. Debug and resolve production integration failures independently, including root-cause analysis and preventative improvements. Instrument integration pipelines with appropriate monitoring, logging, and alerting. Support Marketing Portfolio transition integrations while avoiding unnecessary point-to-point dependencies and new integration debt. Use AI tools to accelerate mapping drafts, API stubs, test generation, documentation, and error-handling boilerplate. Review and harden AI-generated output to ensure it meets production standards for reliability, maintainability, and quality. Automate replay, retry, alerting, and recovery runbooks to reduce mean time to recovery (MTTR). Continuously improve the reliability, observability, and operational efficiency of the integrations you own. Required experience 5+ years of integration engineering experience. Hands-on experience with MuleSoft or an equivalent enterprise ESB/API integration platform. Experience integrating with SAP, including IDoc, API, and/or BAPI patterns. Experience with Salesforce integrations and enterprise API patterns. Experience with data lake ingestion and integration patterns. Strong understanding of API contracts, data mapping, transformations, testing, and integration architecture. Demonstrated experience supporting integrations in production, including monitoring, troubleshooting, alerting, retry/replay, and incident resolution. Ability to take ownership of production issues and drive them through diagnosis, recovery, and prevention, rather than simply handing them off to another team. Experience using AI copilots or agents to accelerate software engineering workflows. Strong engineering judgment and the ability to validate, test, and improve AI-generated code and artifacts before they reach production. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-senior-integration-engineer-for-enterprise-api-integration-products

listings.description: Sprout Social is looking to hire a Senior Manager, Customer Advocacy & Community to the Customer Marketing team. Why join Sprout’s Marketing team? As the social intelligence platform powering the future of customer connection, our Marketing team is the driving force behind turning that vision into reality. We lead with clarity and act with speed to drive market leadership, generate demand, and accelerate customer expansion, all in close partnership with core cross-functional stakeholders. You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, aligning stakeholders and making an impact through thoughtful collaboration and seamless execution. Highlights Location: Serbia Remote Language: Russian-speaking team; English fluency required (C1) About Fundraise Up We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design. Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4. 9 ⁄ 5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver. You should already be using AI meaningfully in your work and understand where it adds value and how it can improve the way you operate. Why work with us A strong, collaborative product team that owns what it builds Clear product vision and access to real customer feedback from global nonprofit leaders Flat structure: no politics, jus

It’s 1813, and Humphrey Davy is dazzling London with scientific demonstrations and lectures. Soon enters the young bookbinder, Michael Faraday, dissatisfied with his own prospects and enamored by the mysteries of electricity. Faraday gets a break and gains an apprenticeship with Davy, and shortly thereafter (partially) blows himself and Davy up in a nitrogen trichloride explosion. We think Davy’s sacrifice was worth it, though, since Faraday went on to do experimental work in the field of electromagnetism that is foundational to innumerable modern technologies. While we can’t promise you’ll become the next Faraday, we can promise you won’t be asked to deal with explosives on the job. Instead, you’ll be receiving mentorship from experienced engineers, writing TypeScript and/or Haskell code, and contributing to a product that serves over 300,000 businesses. Check out demo.mercury.com to see our product for yourself. As an Engineering Intern, you’ll join a team that aligns with your goals and interests. During the interview process, you’ll have the opportunity to talk through the various team openings. All Engineering Interns, regardless of the specific role, should: Be interested in continually honing their craft. Have curiosity and be willing to share their perspective. Appreciate quality in their work and that of others. Communicate well, and be able to write clear explanations of their reasoning on technical decisions. Backend Engineering Interns should have experience using the Haskell programming language, or a strong desire to learn it, and have some familiarity with SQL. In this role you can expect to: Collaborate with data analysts to spec and build features that draw new customers to our product. Provide a backend to our mobile and web frontends, to do things like search transactions or send wire transfers. Build admin tools to increase the efficiency of day-to-day support operations, like identifying fraudulent customers or managing accounts. Integrate with third-party APIs, to do things like send checks or validate SWIFT codes. Frontend Engineering Interns should have experience with the TypeScript programming language, and experience with React is a plus. In this role you can expect to: Work on a beautiful app: Since many of our customers are startups, they appreciate a well-implemented design. We have high standards for our UI, and we think it shows on our website. We encourage you to sign up and check out our onboarding experience, or read our blog post about our date picker. Push the limits of TypeScript: As a financial technology company, preventing errors is a top priority for us, and we take advantage of TypeScript’s advanced static typing features to prevent them. Work in an established codebase that still has room for growth. Across 650K lines of TypeScript, we’ve built abstractions and components that will give you leverage to build great features during your months at Mercury. But there’s still a lot more to build, be it optimizing the scrolling performance of a combobox, or building whole pages to deliver a feature to customers. Exercise ownership over the product: Our engineers work closely with our designers and contribute their own ideas to make the product better. Full-stack Engineering Interns should have experience using the Haskell programming language, or a strong desire to learn it, some familiarity with SQL, and experience using the TypeScript programming language. In this role, you can expect to do a combination of the frontend and backend work that is described above. This is a paid, full-time, remote spring internship for 12-16 weeks between January and May. Our internship program is intended for individuals enrolled in an academic program (undergraduate, graduate, etc.). Individuals interested but not enrolled in an academic program at this time are encouraged to apply to any of our full-time openings. In terms of compensation, the hourly rate for candidates based in the US is $55. The hourly rate for candidates based in Canada is CAD 55. Applications close on September 25th, 2026. Who we are Our mission is to bring clarity and control to the world’s most complex codebases. AI is accelerating code creation, but the infrastructure to understand, oversee, and evolve that code hasn’t kept pace. Sourcegraph gives engineering organizations full visibility across their systems, precise context for their agents, and the ability to execute coordinated code changes at scale. As agentic development becomes the dominant engineering paradigm, we provide the context layer teams need to take control of their codebase. With Code Search, Deep Search, MCP, and Agentic Batch Changes, we deliver on that mission today - giving engineering teams and their AI tools the cross-repo context to navigate massive codebases with confidence, and the ability to make changes across hundreds of repositories at once. Companies like Stripe, Reddit, and Leidos rely on Sourcegraph to ship faster and with higher quality. We’re backed by a16z, Sequoia, and Redpoint, and proud to operate as a globally distributed team that values high agency, direct communication, and customer love. If you want to build the infrastructure that lets every engineering team - and every agent they deploy - operate on their codebase with confidence, join us. The src CLI tool - the command-line surface that humans and the agents they employ use to automate Sourcegraph in their workflows. Kratki uvodni razgovor (30 min, online) Tehnički razgovor s kolegama iz Development tima Kratki praktični zadatak Odluka i ponuda Cijeli proces traje do 3 tjedna.

Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease. Job overview: We are hiring a Engineering Manager to lead two squads building Omada’s Platform and Engineering Systems. These squads own problems from prototype to production, including the maintenance and the on-call rotation for what they ship. You are responsible for those squads: what they work on, in what order, and how your people and teams grow. As a Engineering Manager, you ship code alongside your AI-powered engineers. You own the execution and will run the squad’s rituals: iteration shaping, prioritization, backlog refinement, and initiative estimation are your calls. Being in charge means you have an opinion about the tradeoffs you and the squad are making, and are comfortable partnering with the squad’s stakeholders and finding solutions to problems, should they arise. You partner closely with stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Design, IT, InfoSec, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, and beyond. Your relationships with the people in those departments will be very important. You will manage millions of dollars in annual vendor budget and spending, through key contracts including Amazon Web Services, Datadog, Gitlab, and Anthropic. You will be responsible for annual internal and external audit controls, and must help your teams develop automation and evidence management processes to streamline audit responses. About you: You are comfortable being accountable for what your squad ships. You still write code, and you want to. This role ships production work every sprint, off the critical path, in the same codebase and the same agentic workflows as your squad: you’ll feel the friction your people feel because you experience it first-hand. You are an experienced engineering leader, and you are opinionated about the systems you maintain. You understand why the most important work must be done, and you own the roadmap that will get it done. You are respected technically, but do not need to be the strongest engineer in the squad: your work generally stays off the critical path, but you must possess the fundamental understanding to know what great looks like, and the communication skills to build strong relationships with your teams and colleagues. You are opinionated about where AI-assisted development helps and where it produces work someone else has to redo, because you have first-hand experience from doing the work rather than from reading about it. Above all, you are enthusiastic about providing the best possible care for our members, and building the best engineering team of your career. What you’ll be doing: Managing, Hiring, and Mentoring. You will lead 5 people. You will quickly find opportunities to expand your teams, and must have a strong perspective on how to hire amazing people. Meanwhile, you must ensure that the people who work on your teams today continue growing and challenging themselves. Own the squad’s delivery. Sprint shaping, prioritization, backlog grooming, and estimation are yours. Make the calls, write them down, and be accountable for them. Own cycle time at constant or better quality . Your squad’s contribution to it is yours to move and yours to explain. Ship code. Production work every sprint, off the critical path, using the same agent workflows your squad uses. This is what keeps the standing to review their work and the credibility to defend the model. Grow your engineers. Omadans care about each other: we believe everyone can grow, and you will provide your reports with the best leadership they have ever experienced. Own the operational health of your squad. On-call rotations, MTTR and post-incident analysis are shared work you lead. Escalate early, often, and precisely. You bring tradeoffs, you use your engineering and product taste to come up with recommendations. You will hire the new generation of AI-augmented Omadans. We believe in co-intelligence: we will continue hiring amazing humans, and help them build a career with us. What you need for this role: 8+ years in software engineering, including at least 2 years managing engineers, or equivalent experience leading delivery for a team you were accountable for. A track record shipping mission-critical software to production, and living with it afterwards: we all make mistakes, what separates you from others is that you own these, and use this as an opportunity to build something even greater. The ability to build a roadmap, plan for capacity, evaluate trade-offs, and know how to negotiate with your stakeholders. Experience owning prioritization and estimation for a team, including saying no, not now, and explaining why. Experience giving direct developmental feedback, and at least one case where you managed someone through underperformance with real support attached. Currently shipping, or recently shipping production code in at least one layer of our stack (Multi-account AWS, self-managed continuous integration, k8s, backend (Ruby, Python, …), GitOps release management, internal tools and services) with enough range to follow the conversation in the others and review architecture decisions critically. Hands-on experience directing AI agents through real world production changes, and a considered view on where they help and where they produce work someone else has to redo. Understanding of CI/CD, logging, monitoring, and telemetry, at the level where you can tell whether your squad’s operational story checks out or falls short. A Security-mentality in everything you design and build Excellent written communication. Much of this job is writing things down clearly once so they do not have to be discussed four times. Technologies we use: Architecture & Infrastructure: AWS (EKS, IAM, RDS, SQS, etc), Docker, GitLab, Argo/Kargo, Vault, Datadog, PagerDuty. Application Engineering: Ruby on Rails, Python (Flask, FastAPI), React, native iOS (Swift, SwiftUI), native Android (Kotlin), PostgreSQL, GraphQL, Claude Benefits: Competitive salary

Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease. Job overview: Omada Health is a digital care provider that empowers people to achieve their health goals through sustainable behavioral change. We’re looking for a software engineer to join our Solutions Engineering Team. Our primary function is to understand customer challenges, design tailored technical solutions using Omada’s products and systems, and demonstrate the value and feasibility of those solutions. Your Impact: Build to eliminate the toil. Design, build, and ship home-grown and integrated tooling that removes repetitive, manual work — file processing, migrations, eligibility/contracting/billing edge cases, and the “papercuts” that slow the team down. You’ll own enhancements and moderate-complexity features within our automations and integrations, partnering with commercial, product, and engineering stakeholders along the way. For work that requires deep architectural change or spans many systems, you’ll work alongside the senior engineers and system owners driving that design. See the pain, then help fix it. Sit close enough to implementations and escalations to understand root causes, and contribute to root-cause investigations — flagging when a fix should prevent the fire rather than just put it out. Build with reuse in mind. Use and extend the team’s existing templates, standards, and automation rather than defaulting to one-off customization. Use AI to move faster. Use AI-assisted development and modern automation in your day-to-day work to deliver solutions more quickly. Grow your craft. Pair with more senior engineers to build proficiency across SET’s varied stack, and treat feedback on scope, design, and code quality as a core part of how you improve. Participate in our on-call rotation; triage and address issues that come up supporting members, ensuring timely resolutions and assisting internal teams in their investigations. About you: 3–5 years writing readable, tested, and efficient production code We primarily use Ruby on Rails and are especially interested in candidates with strong Rails experience, but we’re also open to exceptional backend engineers in other languages who are excited to ramp quickly on Rails. Experience with a relational database (PostgreSQL) Experience building and consuming APIs and integrations across service boundaries Fluency with AI-assisted development — you use AI coding assistants in your day-to-day work and have a thoughtful, quality-conscious point of view on where they help and where they don’t Experience with workflow-automation platforms (e.g., Tines, n8n, or similar) and building API-driven automation workflows A track record of shipping measurable improvements to well-defined problems, with the communication skills to translate between business needs and technical reality Solid debugging and optimization skills Strong grasp of SDLC processes and frameworks Comfort ramping onto unfamiliar codebases with support, and the judgment to know when to consult the engineers who own a system. Bonus Points for: Experience with a modern front-end framework (React, Vue) Healthcare or other regulated / data-sensitive domain experience Exposure to a solutions engineering, implementation, or customer-facing technical environment (internship, rotation, or project work counts) Benefits: Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus Equity grants Employee stock purchasing plans (ESPP) Remote first work from home culture Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones Generous parental leave Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions) 401k retirement savings plan Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA) Mental Health Support Solutions …and more! It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada! Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other. Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road. Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers. Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work. Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together. Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it. Today’s healthcare system poorly serves chronic conditions that require ongoing support outside of the exam room, like obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, and musculoskeletal conditions. Omada’s virtual-first model combines human-led care teams, connected devices, and AI-enabled technology to deliver personalized care at scale, including support for GLP-1 therapy. Permanent contract (CDI) Full-time position - 35 hours/week Based in Lyon, France - Open to full remote (based in France) Salary depending on experience About Upfluence Upfluence helps brands tell their story with powerful influencer & content marketing technology. Upfluence’s software allows brands and agencies to identify and contact millions of social influencers and bloggers at scale to execute comprehensive influencer marketing campaigns, as well as provide detailed reporting metrics. Since the launch of our SaaS software in October 2016, the company has yielded a monthly double-digit growth rate, and we are therefore seeking further expansion for our team and offices. Our rapidly growing global team is currently distributed between our offices in NYC, Los Angeles, and Lyon. What We Do We aggregate and serve data for 12M+ influencers across major social networks, which brings exciting engineering challenges around data, scalability, and performance. Our backend stack includes: Languages: Golang, Ruby Databases: PostgreSQL, Apache Cassandra Search & Messaging: Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ Other tech: Apache Thrift (RPC), Prometheus (monitoring) We believe in microservice architecture and domain-driven design, which keeps our systems modular and maintainable; some have been running flawlessly for over 5 years! We’re DevOps-minded: engineers deploy multiple times per day and own their code in production. We automate everything we can with GitHub Actions and in-house tools. Our 100+ microservices run over 1,600 containers, and we’re actively migrating to Kubernetes. Most importantly, we’re product-driven: we write code to make our customers successful, not for the sake of complexity. How We Work We believe collective intelligence drives engineering excellence. Every developer has a voice in technical decisions through proposals and RFCs; we learn, build, and improve together. Our team works in a Scrum framework with 2-week sprints, combining focus and flexibility. Each sprint starts with clear goals and ends with a review and retrospective to continuously improve our process. We value transparency, shared ownership, and cross-team collaboration so everyone knows how their work impacts the product. We also love open source and regularly share our libraries with the community. The Role As a Software Engineer, you will: Write reliable, maintainable, and well-tested code. Be part of the entire feature lifecycle, from design to production and long-term maintenance. Collaborate closely with teammates, review PRs, and contribute to technical discussions. Work hand-in-hand with Customer Success and Support teams to ensure a great user experience. Who we’re looking for: You don’t need to be a Golang expert; we’re looking for fast learners who are curious and eager to grow. You’ll thrive here if you: Enjoy solving complex technical problems with a pragmatic mindset. Communicate clearly and proactively. Are comfortable working in English (French not required). Care about building a product that truly helps users. Are reliable, collaborative, and open to feedback. What we have to offer: Your spot with the team in one of our awesome Lyon office, or even remote, either way, is fine with us. You’ll be answering issues on Github and making bad jokes on Discord anyway! An entrepreneurial and dynamic startup environment with room for growth. A mixed and international team (22+ nationalities). An empowering and autonomous position in an entrepreneurial environment. Regular exchanges with the US/FR offices. Stock options. The answer to life, the universe, and everything. Join a motivated and growing team! Discover our Stack: https://stackshare.io/upfluence/upfluence Sounds like the perfect opportunity? Apply now to join us! We offer a flexible hybrid work model, providing our employees with an office setting, the option to work from home, and even fully remote structures. We believe in work-life balance and provide access so we can make the best of our workdays. Upfluence is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

What’s in it for you? Ready to make a serious impact? Millions of people already rely on Calendly, and we’re still in the midst of exciting product growth — it’s a fantastic time to join us. Everything you’ll work on here will accelerate your career to the next level. If you want to learn, grow, and do the best work of your life alongside the best people you’ve ever worked with, then we hope you’ll consider allowing Calendly to be a part of your professional journey. About the team & opportunity What’s so great about working on Calendly’s Engineering team? We make things possible for our customers through innovation. We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer who will bring deep technical know-how, system design knowledge and a healthy dose of fun to the team. You will report to the Engineering Manager for the Notetaker group and will play a key role in designing and supporting the core features and architecture that underpin Calendly’s AI Notetaker and meeting recaps. A day in the life of a Full Stack Engineer at Calendly The Calendly Notetaker is built on a modern, service-based architecture and is scaling usage and user-base rapidly - targeting significant further growth over the course of 2026. We need ambitious, experienced engineers who can help us drive this stage of growth. As an engineer at Calendly, you will both build new features and work to scale our platform and architecture. You will build tooling and automation to fine tune our delivery process as you grow into a service oriented specialist. You will also learn to work with multiple technologies such as Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Argo Workflows, NodeJS, React, Golang, PostgreSQL, Redis, to name a few. When you join Calendly, you get the opportunity to deliver on a product used by millions and known for its best-in-class quality. Help us continue to deliver critical features to our users with excellence. On a typical day, you will be working on: Collaborate within your team to build new features that expand Notetaker functionality and add support for additional user types. Contribute to platform scaling initiatives. Meet regularly with Product and Design to fine tune requirements. Attend agile ceremonies to help your team plan out their work and get it done. Work across squads to improve Engineering practices at Calendly. Review implementation plans and pull requests from your peers. Mentor and coach other team members. What do we need from you? 7+ years of Software Development experience at a SaaS or technology company. Professional experience with Node is preferred. Experience with React or a comparable UI framework is also desirable. Professional experience with TypeScript. Ability to adapt to new technologies, changing requirements, and evolving organizational needs Hands-on experience with Service-Oriented Architectures (SOA), microservices, and involvement in significant product-scaling initiatives. Proven ability to own features end-to-end, including technical discovery, implementation, testing, release, and ongoing maintenance. Experience using AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, etc.) as productivity tools, with a clear understanding of generated code and the ability to defend implementation choices. Availability for participation in on-call rotation, ensuring prompt and effective responses to business-critical alerts outside of regular working hours Authorized to work lawfully in the United States of America as Calendly does not engage in immigration sponsorship at this time. Calendly takes a number of factors into consideration when determining an employee’s starting salary, including relevant experience, relevant skills sets, interview performance, location/metropolitan area, and internal pay equity. Base salary is just one component of Calendly’s total rewards package. All full-time (30 hours/week) employees are also eligible for equity awards, and competitive benefits. Eligible Sales employees also qualify for a Sales Incentive program. Current geographic zones are as follows: Tier 1: San Francisco, CA, San Jose, CA, New York City, NY Tier 2: Chicago, IL, Austin, TX, Denver, CO, Boston, MA, Washington D.C., Philadelphia, PA, Portland, OR, Seattle, WA, Miami, FL, and all other cities in CA. Tier 3: All other locations not in Tier 1 or Tier 2 If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application or recruiting process, please let your Recruiter know when first connecting with them. Calendly is registered as an employer in many, but not all, states. If you are located in Alaska, Delaware, Hawaii, Idaho, Iowa, Montana, Nebraska, North Dakota, Rhode Island, South Dakota, and West Virginia, you will not be eligible for employment. Note that all individual roles will specify location eligibility. listings.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: We’re building the next chapter: an agentic platform that understands operational context and takes action, with the ambition to make physical operations increasingly autonomous. External Platform EMEA owns critical capabilities behind that transition. Depending on the team, your work could include: Reporting and intelligence. Own the reporting engine and products that turn the complexity of a fleet into answers customers can act on. Enterprise administration. Build how customers configure and control Samsara at scale, from permissions and device metadata to AI-assisted onboarding. Developer and agent platform. Build APIs, event systems, integrations, and tools that give applications and AI agents access to operational data and actions. Business-critical infrastructure. Own billing, license assignment, and usage metering: systems central to how Samsara sells, delivers, and grows its products. In this role, you will: Lead technical discussions with teammates to identify gaps in our telematics data platform and influence roadmap by setting direction and recommending solutions Collaborate with other engineering teams to make design decisions and understand downstream implications in our product to ensure a seamless customer experience Ship features that deliver value to customers, consistently refining them based on gathered feedback. Deliver full stack features across multiple tiers (front-end, back-end and mobile). GoLang, GraphQL, Typescript, React and ReactNative among other technologies. Direct experience with these technologies is not required. Be responsible for maintaining the production systems that your team owns and provide operational support. Make an impact on our core architecture, roadmap, and the wider engineering community. Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team Minimum requirements for the role: 7+ years of experience designing and building products in a software engineering team Proven experience leading the design, development, deployment, and ongoing maintenance of highly scalable, distributed software systems Proven experience in building, deploying, and maintaining Machine Learning-powered products Experience mentoring and supporting engineers and role modeling engineering practices within a technical lead capacity Experience taking end-to-end ownership of product, feature designs, development and delivery of large scale and long running projects Proactive growth mindset, always looking at ways to improve the status quo B.S. in Computer Science or related technical discipline An ideal candidate also has: Experience building customer-facing web and mobile workflow applications Contributed heavily to driving significant value to their customers Curiosity about our customers, and is eager to improve their day-to-day experience Seeks to iterate on new products based on customer feedback Exceptional problem-solving abilities and meticulous attention to detail.Strong communication skills for effective teamwork and project collaboration. Enthusiastic and committed to innovating in a fast-paced and dynamic team environment. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. Who we are At Fluxon, we believe that how you build matters as much as what you build. We help businesses navigate their most important technology decisions with confidence, and take responsibility for seeing them through. Founded by ex-Googlers and startup veterans, we’re proud to partner with teams behind some of the most ambitious products, including Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Walmart and Stripe. Our work spans strategy, design, and engineering — often in complex, AI-driven environments — where clarity, speed and quality are the standard. We use AI intentionally, applying it only where it adds real value and expands what’s possible. Care shapes everything we do. Inside Fluxon, you’ll find a global, remote-first team of experienced builders, who are curious, kind and serious about their craft. We’re building a place where people can take ownership, solve problems that matter and do work they’re proud to stand behind. If you want to do your best work alongside people who care as much as you do, you’ll feel at home here. This role is fully remote, with candidates based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. About the role As a Staff Software Engineer at Fluxon, you’ll play a key role in shaping the technical direction of our engineering organization. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company. We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! THE OPPORTUNITY We are hiring a Senior Backend Software Engineer to join our Identity Experience (IDX) team in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil. We’re looking for an autonomous and resourceful Senior Software Engineer to join our international Identity Experience (IDX) team. The IDX team owns critical services at the heart of our product, including account creation, account management, account recovery, permissions management, and more. In this role, you’ll build features that sit at the spine of the product and power experiences used by millions of users. You’ll tackle complex engineering challenges where performance, reliability, and scalability are essential, while designing and evolving systems built to operate at massive scale. You’ll also play a key role in driving our AI transformation, leveraging your experience with AI-assisted development to raise engineering standards, accelerate delivery, and build seamless, reliable identity experiences. THE OPPORTUNITY Drive and own critical core identity services, including account creation, account management, permissions management, and account recovery. Architect and build scalable, highly resilient backend systems to support global user growth. Optimize system performance and infrastructure efficiency across core microservices. Develop high-impact new products and features with a high degree of autonomy and resourcefulness. Lead AI transformation within the team by leveraging AI-assisted development practices to elevate engineering standards. Collaborate closely with international cross-functional teams, UX, and product leadership to deliver seamless identity experiences. Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance. YOUR IMPACT You are an experienced software engineer that worked building and operating backend systems in production environments. Golang expertise is highly desirable. You have strong experience with distributed systems, APIs, data-intensive applications, large-scale cloud-native architectures and scalable databases such as PostgreSQL, with experience designing and scaling systems on platforms such as Google Cloud Platform or AWS. You have hands-on experience with Kubernetes or similar container orchestration platforms, including deploying, scaling, and operating services in production. You can independently own projects end-to-end , from technical design through implementation and operation, while collaborating effectively with engineers across teams. You care deeply about maintainable, reliable code , make thoughtful technical decisions, and continuously look for ways to improve production systems. You communicate clearly and confidently , and are comfortable driving technical discussions, influencing decisions, and sharing ideas across teams. You have a high level of AI fluency and thoughtfully leverage modern tools, including LLMs and AI-assisted development, to improve engineering workflows and problem-solving. We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don’t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in building and operating distributed backend systems at scale is a mandatory requirement . Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs! Our benefits include: WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content. HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance. FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office. Fingerprint empowers enterprises to detect and stop online fraud with the world’s most accurate device intelligence. We lead our industry with bleeding-edge identification capabilities and work on turning new ideas and discoveries in the fraud detection space into reality. Our customers range from innovative startups to leading enterprise companies, including Plaid, Dropbox, and Booking.com. Fingerprint is a globally dispersed, 100% remote company. We were named on on the 2026 Forbes Best Startup Employers list and ranked #803 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies. We have raised $77M and are backed by Craft Ventures (Tesla, Facebook, Airbnb ), Nexus Venture Partners ( Postman, Apollo.io, MinIO, Druva) and Uncorrelated Ventures ( Redis, Rollbar, Gradle). About the role We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to help build and operate the end-to-end fraud detection systems behind our Identification APIs. Your primary responsibility will be building highly performant backend systems and keeping them reliable at scale. You’ll write the services and you’ll own how they behave in production. This role requires strong experience in backend software development, particularly API development and scaling existing systems in Go, paired with a genuine interest in reliability engineering. You’ll design and implement scalable, high-performance backend systems, maintain their SLOs, and take ownership of features from concept through deployment and steady-state operation. A key aspect of this role involves a deep understanding of scaling and operating distributed systems, allowing us to multiply our capacity safely and efficiently as our user base continues to grow rapidly. Responsibilities Design, build, and optimize backend systems for real-time data processing and web services, treating reliability, latency, and cost as first-class constraints. Own SLIs and SLOs for Core API services, using error budgets to balance shipping velocity against stability. Build the observability that makes systems debuggable — metrics, structured logging, distributed tracing, and alerts that fire on user-visible symptoms, not noise. Share an on-call rotation, respond effectively to incidents, and lead blameless postmortems. Schedules are set in advance, with equitable coverage and minimal off-hours disruption. Reduce operational toil through automation, and close out incident action items so the same failure doesn’t recur. Run capacity planning, load testing, and performance tuning so the platform scales ahead of demand. Partner with cross-functional teams on integrations, and mentor other engineers as they grow. Qualifications 5+ years in backend development, including meaningful time operating what you built in production. Strong, demonstrated experience with Go, and with scalable APIs, real-time data processing, and microservices. Hands-on experience running production services with Docker and Kubernetes, and with IaC tools like Terraform or CloudFormation. Working fluency with observability tooling (Datadog or comparable) — instrumenting services and building useful dashboards and alerts. On-call experience: triaging live incidents, mitigating impact, and writing up what happened. Strong SQL, plus experience with databases like DynamoDB, Redis, or Elasticsearch. Proficiency with Git, shell scripting, and CI/CD, and fluency in English for a global, remote team. Able to work independently in ambiguous environments with direct stakeholder contact, and eager to mentor junior engineers. BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience. Bonus: analytical storage systems (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), queueing and streaming systems (SQS, Kafka), or performance profiling and cost optimization of high-throughput cloud workloads. Bonus: vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant) in production, ML-adjacent product engineering, concurrent programming, or a strong grasp of internet security and privacy mechanisms. Tools and Technologies: Backend development: Golang Infrastructure and delivery: AWS, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines. Observability: Datadog, metrics/logging/tracing. Data analytics/processing: ClickHouse, dbt. Compensation & Transparency For US-based employees, the cash compensation range for this role is $152,000 – $205,000. We set standard ranges for all US roles based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. To comply with local legislation and provide greater transparency, we share salary ranges on all job postings. However, these ranges are specific to the hiring location and may differ within or outside the US. Offers vary depending on, but not limited to, relevant experience, education, certifications/licenses, skills, training, and market conditions. Due to regulatory and security reasons, there’s a small number of countries where we cannot have Fingerprint teammates based. Additionally, because Fingerprint is an all-remote company and people can join our workforce from almost any country, we do not sponsor visas. Fingerprint teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive work environment for everyone. We embrace and celebrate the unique experiences, perspectives and cultural backgrounds that each employee brings to our workplace. Fingerprint strives to foster an environment where our employees feel respected, valued and empowered, and our team members are at the forefront in helping us promote and sustain an inclusive workplace. We highly encourage people from underrepresented groups in tech to apply. If you are applying as a resident of California, please read our CCPA notice here. If you are applying as a resident of the EU, please read our GDPR notice here. Convoso is a leading AI-powered contact center platform purpose-built for revenue teams. Since 2006, Convoso has remained at the forefront of innovation, consistently developing solutions to drive customer growth while supporting adherence to regulatory standards. Who We Are: While headquartered in Los Angeles, the Convoso team can be found around the globe working in either a hybrid or remote capacity. Awarded as a “best place to work” company, our culture fosters team integrity, positive persistence, and continuous growth. Our core platform powers successful sales teams across multiple industries, giving our customers a competitive edge and streamlined productivity. With built-in Al and automations, our product is a premium offering in a competitive space. We continue to grow our product capabilities to better serve our current customers and to expand into newer markets. Convoso is looking for people who are excited about technology and innovation. We are a company of motivated team players with diverse backgrounds driving accelerated growth in a supportive, positive culture. Most roles at Convoso function as “hybrid” with some opportunities for travel to in-person business events and company meetings. For remote positions, Convoso’s U.S. hiring is open to candidates residing anywhere within the United States. The Job: Convoso is seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to help architect and build the next generation of our high-volume, real-time communication platform. We are not just looking for someone who knows a single telecom technology—we are looking for a distributed systems engineer who has built large-scale, high-concurrency communications platforms where milliseconds matter. In this role, you will help rebuild and modernize our core platform in Go (Golang) , designing high-performance backend microservices that handle massive call volumes, real-time event routing, voice media streaming, and large-scale analytics with carrier-grade reliability. Responsibilities summary: 1. Distributed Backend & Next-Gen Architecture (Go) Architect, write, and maintain production-grade microservices in Go (Golang) to power Convoso’s next-generation SaaS platform. Design high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems that seamlessly coordinate call routing, reporting, AI processing, and customer data synchronization across services. Utilize modern messaging and event-streaming technologies (NATS, JetStream, Kafka) to handle massive event volumes reliably and asynchronously. 2.
